name: Bread and Circuses
summary: Holly Aster and Siv Harga each mean to serve the mayor's table at the Founders' feast.

stages.journal: Holly the baker and Siv the butcher each want the mayor's table at the Founders' feast, and each thinks the other cheats.
objectives: Take the verdict to the mayor
stages.hint: Visit Siv at the butcher's, then take your verdict to Mayor Somerton.

stages.journal: The Founders' feast is over. An ode was read.
